## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### Through an API

api (fal.ai) · $0.075/sec · [fal.ai](https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/hunyuan-video-v1.5/text-to-video)

<sub>[price source](https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/hunyuan-video-v1.5/text-to-video): USD per second of generated video, 480p (the only resolution offered on this endpoint). Product: fal HunyuanVideo 1.5 text-to-video endpoint. API model: fal-ai/hunyuan-video-v1.5/text-to-video. Price basis: the page's endpoint billing record states billing\_unit=seconds, price=0.075, and the sibling image-to-video page states "$0.075 per second"; the page's prose says "0.075 cents/s", which is taken as a typo for $0.075/s on the strength of the billing record. Currency: USD. fal.ai model page, observed 2026-09-25.</sub>

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (BF16, needs ~20.42 GB, NVIDIA only, from [github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan](https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/HunyuanVideo-1.5))
   
   ```sh
   torchrun --nproc_per_node=1 generate.py --prompt "A cat walks on the grass, realistic style." --resolution 480p --rewrite false --model_path ./ckpts
   ```

Other versions: fp16 720p T2V (sd.cpp) (~43.9 GB) `sd-cli -M vid_gen --diffusion-model models/hunyuanvideo1.5_720p_t2v_fp16.safetensors --vae models/hunyuanvideo15_vae_fp16.safetensors --llm models/qwen_2.5_vl_7b.safetensors --t5xxl models/byt5_small_glyphxl_fp16.safetensors -p "a lovely cat" --cfg-scale 6.0 --sampling-method euler -v -W 1280 -H 720 --offload-to-cpu --diffusion-fa --video-frames 33 --vae-tiling` · fp16 720p T2V + Qwen2.5-VL q8_0 (sd.cpp) (~33.8 GB) `sd-cli -M vid_gen --diffusion-model models/hunyuanvideo1.5_720p_t2v_fp16.safetensors --vae models/hunyuanvideo15_vae_fp16.safetensors --llm models/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct.Q8_0.gguf --t5xxl models/byt5_small_glyphxl_fp16.safetensors -p "a lovely cat" --cfg-scale 6.0 --sampling-method euler -v -W 1280 -H 720 --offload-to-cpu --diffusion-fa --video-frames 33 --vae-tiling`
